item.title: Migrated to Hugo
item.description: I’ve been using Jekyll for this blog for more the 12 years. It was great at the time, but over the years I found myself getting more and more frustrated with the only constant in the Ruby/Gem/Bundler stack: never ending breaking changes. I don’t really know what’s going on in that space and that’s the second issue I had with Jekyll, I treated it like a blackbox cause I had no desire to get into Ruby and still don’t unless I need to professionally.
